doc: What the visitor does on the page by themselves, for a site that wants the agent to know: the part of the page they stay on, and the forms they fill in (field names only, never what they type). The page's watchers report them (`watchThings`, `watchForms` in @voqalize/stage); by default the agent keeps where they are reading to itself and hears one line when a form changes. A site makes either speak by choosing `react` for it when it takes the kit.

slices.doc: the part of the page the visitor has stayed on, by its heading
the form the visitor is filling in: which fields hold something and which required ones are still empty, by name, never their values

events.doc: The visitor stayed on another part of the page.

events.note: {by} is filling in {form}: {left} required fields left
events.doc: The visitor filled or emptied fields of a form, and then paused.
